name: kiasumiles
description: Singapore credit-card miles optimizer with a persistent local wallet.

interface.shortDescription: Ask Codex which Singapore miles card to use at a merchant.
interface.longDescription: Your KiasuMiles card wallet is saved on this device and automatically used for recommendations from the live hosted service. The hosted service does not store your wallet.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use KiasuMiles to help me choose the best card for a Singapore merchant.
